title: Retain portable workspace assignment and release history
preconditions: Use workplan assigned item and workspace provider devswarm, stable workspace/repository IDs, branch feature/work, source branch main and role owner.

steps.action: Record assigned, then released with the assigned event URN as parent; reload plan.
steps.expected_result: Release has a distinct event identity, its parent is the assignment, and no local worktree/terminal/pane identity is stored.

steps.action: Query work-events --kind workspace and work-items for assigned.
steps.expected_result: Both assignment/release actions expose the original portable identities, role and branch context; released assignment is no longer active.

expected_result: Ownership remains portable and historically inspectable after release.
